ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. Accepting never unmutes the agent. The consent statement the owner agrees to by pressing Accept; the key names the participation version it is consent to (bridge_agent_participation_v1), so ANY change to this English text needs a new version and a new key. Keep both facts: from now on the agent can read the conversation's messages AND post there; it is woken only when someone @-mentions it. Do not say 'muted' (the app's Mute level means never notified).

findings.issue: When the agent has no stored name (blank or the legacy 'Member' label) the code fills {agent} with agent_fallback. The hi fallback is the direct form 'आपका एजेंट', but all three hosts put {agent} before a postposition, so the rendered sentences are ungrammatical: 'आपका एजेंट को इस बातचीत में आमंत्रित किया गया है', 'आपका एजेंट को सिर्फ़ तब जगाया जाता है…', 'आपका एजेंट के लिए अस्वीकार किया गया।' (oblique 'आपके एजेंट' required).
findings.evidence: IntlMessageFormat render with {agent}=agent_fallback (render-1446.txt); call site team-bridge-invitations.tsx:257 `invitation.agentName ?? t(agent_fallback)`; storedLabel() returns null for blank/'Member'.
findings.fix: Catalogue-only: in hi every host is oblique, so agent_fallback 'आपके एजेंट' renders correctly in all three (a named agent is unaffected).
